verdict.rationale: WorkOS docs state its SSO service works with any IdP that supports SAML or OIDC, and position enterprise single sign-on as a core product with self-serve IT-admin onboarding. Hands-on community reports independently praise how easy WorkOS's wizard makes SAML configuration and note its built-in integrations with many providers. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation naming Okta, Entra, and Google Workspace as supported connections, and detailed connection-setup docs in the pack beyond one-line protocol claims.
